label: Assess
description: When you study a place, a person, or a threat, roll +Wits.

bands.text: Ask the GM two questions about it. The answers are true and useful.
Ask the GM one question. The answer is true, but it costs time, noise, or exposure.
The GM reveals a danger you missed, or something notices you first.

label: Sneak
description: When you move unseen or unheard, roll +Reflexes with Stealth.

bands.text: You get there unseen and unheard.
You get there, but leave a sign, are seen, or lose something on the way.
You are caught, cornered, or ambushed.

label: Scavenge
description: When you search a site for supplies, roll +Wits with Scavenging.

bands.text: You find what you need, and something extra.
You find something useful, but choose one: it takes time, it makes noise, it is in poor condition, or a complication arrives.

choices.label: It takes time
choices.text: The search takes longer than you wanted.

effects.text: The search takes time and the scene moves on.

choices.label: It makes noise
choices.text: Something shifts and falls.

choices.label: It is in poor condition
choices.text: The loot is worn or broken.

effects.text: The loot is in poor condition.

choices.label: A complication arrives
choices.text: Someone or something else is here.

effects.text: A complication arrives at the site.

bands.text: Nothing useful, or something dangerous. The GM makes a move.

label: Forage
description: When you find food and water in the wild, roll +Wits with Survival.

bands.text: You find food and water for the day, and a little extra.
You find one of the two, or both with a cost: time, distance, or contamination.
Nothing, or something contaminated. The GM makes a move.

label: Track
description: When you follow a trail or read the ground, roll +Wits with Survival.

bands.text: You follow the trail, and learn something useful about what made it.
You follow it, but lose time or take a risk.
You lose the trail, or walk into danger.

label: Fix
description: When you repair or jury-rig gear, roll +Know-how with Mechanics.

bands.text: It works, and works better than before.
It works, but it needs parts, time, or a new condition.
It breaks worse. The GM makes a move.

label: Treat
description: When you treat a wound or a condition, roll +Know-how with Medicine.

bands.text: Clear 1 harm and one condition, or stabilize a dying character.
Stabilize, or clear one thing with a cost: supplies, time, or risk.
It worsens, or infection sets in.

label: Persuade
description: When you talk someone into something, roll +Presence with Persuasion.

bands.text: They agree, and they do not hold it against you.
They agree, with a price, a favour, or a condition.
They refuse, take offence, or raise the price.

label: Command
description: When you order followers or civilians, roll +Presence with Persuasion.

bands.text: They act, and they hold.
They act with hesitation, or at a cost.
They refuse, freeze, or panic.

label: Trade
description: When you barter goods or services, roll +Presence with Persuasion.

bands.text: A fair deal, and something extra.
A deal with a catch: a condition, a debt, or a poor exchange.
No deal, or a bad reputation.

label: Engage
description: When you fight hand to hand, roll +Grit or +Reflexes with Melee.

bands.text: You deal harm and keep control of the fight.
You deal harm, and suffer a consequence.

choices.label: Take a hit
choices.text: You take harm in return.

choices.label: Get pinned
choices.text: You are driven back and held.

choices.label: Start bleeding
choices.text: The wound is worse than it looked.

bands.text: You miss, and the GM makes a hard move.

label: Shoot
description: When you fire a ranged weapon at a target, roll +Reflexes with Firearms.

bands.text: You hit and choose an effect: pin them, drive them back, or break their cover.
You hit, but choose one: expose yourself, spend extra ammo, or take a consequence.

choices.label: Expose yourself
choices.text: You have to step out to make the shot.

choices.label: Spend extra ammo
choices.text: You empty more of the magazine than you meant to.

choices.label: Take a consequence
choices.text: The shot costs you something.

bands.text: You miss, jam, or run dry. The GM makes a move.

label: Defend
description: When you hold a line, protect someone, or get clear, roll +Grit with Melee or Athletics.

bands.text: You hold, redirect, or get someone clear without harm.
You hold, but take harm or a cost.

choices.label: Take harm
choices.text: You hold and pay for it.

choices.label: Give ground
choices.text: You are pushed back and pinned.

bands.text: You are overrun.

label: Defy Danger
description: When you react to immediate danger, roll +the stat your approach uses and the skill it fits.

bands.text: You avoid it cleanly.
You avoid the worst of it, and choose a cost.

choices.label: Take harm
choices.text: You get clear, but not clean.

choices.label: Lose something
choices.text: Something you were carrying is gone or broken.

effects.text: You lose or break something in the scramble.

choices.label: Take a condition
choices.text: The effort leaves you exposed.

bands.text: You suffer it, and the GM makes a hard move.

label: Flee
description: When you run, drive, or slip away, roll +Reflexes with Athletics or Driving.

bands.text: You escape.
You escape, but at a cost: something is left behind, or someone is hurt.
You are trapped, separated, or worse.

label: Drive
description: When you control a vehicle under pressure, roll +Reflexes with Driving.

bands.text: You keep control and gain the advantage.
You keep control, but the vehicle or the situation pays for it.
You crash, stall, or lose control.

label: Craft
description: When you make something from parts, roll +Know-how with Mechanics.

bands.text: It works, and it is solid.
It works, with a flaw, a shortage, or a shorter life.
The materials are wasted, or the failure is dangerous.

label: Salvage
description: When you strip a site or a wreck for parts, roll +Wits with Scavenging.

bands.text: You get the parts, and something extra.
You get parts, but at a cost: time, noise, or a hazard.
Nothing useful, or a hazard. The GM makes a move.

label: Recuperate
description: When you rest and recover under pressure, roll +Grit or +Presence with Survival or Medicine.

bands.text: Clear 1 harm and shake off a condition.
Clear some of it, with a cost: time, shelter, or supplies.
The rest is interrupted, or it does not take.

label: Harm Move
description: When you take 2 or more harm in one hit, or any harm while wounded, roll +Grit.

bands.text: You keep your feet and can still act.
Choose one: drop what you are holding, lose your position, hesitate, or take a condition.

choices.label: Drop what you are holding
choices.text: It clatters away from you.

effects.text: You drop what you are holding.

choices.label: Lose your position
choices.text: You are driven back or exposed.

choices.label: Hesitate
choices.text: The moment gets away from you.

choices.label: Take a condition
choices.text: The hit leaves a mark.

bands.text: The GM makes a hard move: worse harm, separation, capture, or lost gear.

label: Resist Infection
description: When a deep bite, dirty wound, or contamination puts infection in you, roll +Grit with Survival.

bands.text: No infection takes hold.
The infection starts slowly. Mark 1 infection.
The infection takes hold fast. Mark 2 infection.

label: Face Horror
description: When you confront an eldritch entity or a strange horror, roll +Presence.

bands.text: You hold yourself together.
You mark Dread, or take a condition.

choices.label: Shaken
choices.text: Your nerve is gone for now.

choices.label: Reeling
choices.text: Your mind will not settle.

bands.text: You panic, mark 2 Dread, and the GM makes a hard move.

label: Order Follower
description: When you send a follower into danger, roll +Presence with Persuasion.

bands.text: They do it, and they come back.
They do it, with hesitation, or at a cost.
They refuse, freeze, or break.

label: Train
description: When you spend downtime learning, roll +Know-how or +Wits.

bands.text: You learn the knowledge move, or add practice to a skill.
You make progress, with time, cost, or partial understanding.
No progress, or a dangerous mistake.

label: Skill Check
description: When the outcome of an ordinary task is uncertain, roll +the stat and the skill that fit the work.

bands.text: It works.
It works, with a cost or a complication.
It fails, or it costs more than you meant to spend.

label: Radio Operation
description: When you call for help, intercept a signal, jam a frequency, or reach a distant station, roll +Wits.

bands.text: You get through, clearly, and learn something worth the call.
You get through, but the signal is weak, overheard, or costly in time.
Static, a hostile voice, or nothing at all. The GM makes a move.

label: Computer Use
description: When you recover data, hack a system, control a machine, or read a drive, roll +Know-how with Mechanics.

bands.text: You get what you came for, and the system does not notice.
You get it, but leave a trace, trip an alarm, or lose time.
The system locks you out, or something responds.

label: Cybernetics Configuration
description: When you install, calibrate, maintain, or disable an implant, roll +Know-how with Medicine.

bands.text: The implant works cleanly, and Rejection does not rise.
It works, but the body complains. Mark 1 Rejection.
The implant fights the body. Mark 2 Rejection and take a condition.

label: Field Surgery
description: When you stabilize, remove a bullet, amputate, or install an implant in the field, roll +Know-how with Medicine.

bands.text: The work is clean. Clear the bleeding and stabilize the patient.
The work holds, but it costs supplies or leaves a condition.
It goes badly: bleeding, infection, and the GM makes a move.

label: Vehicle Repair
description: When you fix, modify, or jury-rig a vehicle, roll +Know-how with Mechanics.

bands.text: The vehicle is sound, and you improve something while you are in there.
It runs, but it needs parts, time, or a new condition.
It fails worse, or the repair draws attention.

label: Occult Lore
description: When you identify a relic, a rite, a sign, or an eldritch weakness, roll +Wits.

bands.text: You know what it is, what it wants, and what would hurt it.
You learn something true, and it costs you. Mark 1 Dread.
You learn too much. Mark 1 Dread and take a condition.

label: Demolitions
description: When you place, disarm, or improvise explosives, roll +Know-how with Mechanics.

bands.text: The charge does exactly what you meant it to do.
It works, but late, loud, or short. The GM says which.
It goes off early, badly, or not at all. The GM makes a move.

label: Chemistry
description: When you make drugs, fuel, purification, poisons, or medicine, roll +Know-how with Medicine.

bands.text: The batch is clean and potent.
It works, but it is weak, unstable, or short a dose.
The work spoils, or something in it is dangerous.

label: Navigate
description: When you cross a city street, a district, or a danger zone, roll +Wits or +Reflexes with Survival, Stealth, or Athletics.

bands.text: You pick the way through and get there unseen. Ask one true thing about the route.
You get there, but choose one: lose time, make noise, or draw attention.

choices.label: Lose time
choices.text: The way is longer than it looked.

effects.text: The crossing takes longer than expected; the day moves on.

choices.label: Make noise
choices.text: Something underfoot gives the party away.

choices.label: Draw attention
choices.text: Someone watches the party cross.

bands.text: You are cut off, seen, or cornered. The GM makes a hard move.
